decisions.chain_element: curate sequence data and corresponding textual annotations from the NCBI nt Database up to April, 2023

decisions.chain_element: organize the sequence data with the text annotations as feature-ordered input

decisions.rationale: R6: organizing data with annotations as feature-ordered prompt input is serialization.

decisions.chain_element: partition the data into sentence-based chunks

decisions.chain_element: tokenize with SentencePiece byte pair encoding

evidence.quote: The data were tokenized with the byte pair encoding (BPE) algorithm 11 .

decisions.rationale: R6: SentencePiece byte pair encoding is tokenization.

operation_proposals.source_operation: estimate log-likelihood difference between paired nucleotide sequences
operation_proposals.why_no_existing_operation: The catalog does not represent model log-likelihood estimation or differencing; log_transform applies a logarithm to supplied values and add performs element-wise addition.
The catalog has no score-computation primitive for deriving a mutation effect from model likelihoods.
The catalog does not encode model likelihood estimation or likelihood differences; its log_transform and add operations have different semantics.
A model-derived mutation-effect score is a computed evaluation quantity without a corresponding catalog operation.
